tools.title: AI Resume Checker
tools.tagline: Get instant feedback on your resume
tools.description: Free AI resume checker. Get detailed feedback on your resume — ATS compatibility, formatting, content quality, and actionable improvement suggestions.

fields.label: Target job description (optional)
fields.placeholder: Paste the job posting for targeted feedback...

{resume}
"""

faq.q: How does the AI resume checker work?
faq.a: Our AI analyzes your resume for ATS compatibility, content quality, formatting, and keyword optimization. It provides a score out of 100 and specific improvement suggestions.
Yes, completely free. No signup, no watermark, no limits.

tools.title: ATS Resume Score
tools.description: Free ATS resume score checker. See how well your resume passes Applicant Tracking Systems with detailed keyword analysis and optimization tips.

fields.label: Job description
fields.placeholder: Paste the job posting to check keyword match...

tools.systemPrompt: You are an ATS (Applicant Tracking System) expert. Score resumes for ATS compatibility.
tools.userPrompt:
Analyze this resume against the job description for ATS compatibility.

Provide:
1. ATS SCORE: X/100
2. KEYWORD MATCH: List matched and missing keywords
3. FORMAT CHECK: ✅ or ❌ for each (no tables, no columns, no graphics, standard headings, proper dates, contact info)
4. SECTION ANALYSIS: Score each section
5. TOP 10 MISSING KEYWORDS to add
6. REWRITTEN SUMMARY optimized for this job

Resume:
"""
{resume}
"""

Job Description:
"""
{jobDesc}
"""

faq.a: ATS score measures how well your resume matches a job description for Applicant Tracking Systems. Higher scores mean better chances of passing the automated screening.

tools.title: Resume Summary Generator
tools.description: Free AI resume summary generator. Create a professional summary that highlights your experience, skills, and achievements in 3-5 sentences.

fields.label: Key skills
fields.placeholder: e.g. Python, AWS, Docker, React, Team Leadership

fields.label: Top achievements
fields.placeholder: e.g. Led team of 10, Reduced costs by 30%, Built platform serving 1M users

tools.systemPrompt: You are an expert resume writer. Write professional resume summaries.
tools.userPrompt:
Write 3 different professional resume summaries (5-7 sentences each) for:

Title: {title}
Experience: {experience} years
Skills: {skills}
{achievements ? 'Achievements: ' + achievements : ''}

Each summary should:
- Start with a power phrase
- Include years of experience
- Mention 3-4 key skills
- Include a measurable achievement
- Be ATS-optimized

Label them: Option 1, Option 2, Option 3

tools.title: AI Text Humanizer
tools.description: Free AI humanizer tool. Transform robotic AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing that bypasses AI detectors.

fields.label: Paste AI-generated text
fields.placeholder: Paste the AI text you want to humanize...

tools.systemPrompt: You are an expert editor who transforms AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing. Never mention you are AI. Write as a human would.
tools.userPrompt:
Rewrite this AI-generated text to sound completely natural and human.

Tone: {tone}

Rules:
- Vary sentence length (mix short and long)
- Use contractions naturally
- Add occasional filler words
- Use specific examples instead of generic statements
- Avoid lists unless the original has them
- Don't start sentences with "In today's" or "In the realm of"
- Remove AI patterns like "It's important to note" or "Furthermore"

Text to humanize:
"""
{text}
"""

faq.a: Our humanizer rewrites text with natural patterns, varied sentence structures, and human-like expressions. While no tool guarantees 100% bypass, it significantly improves natural readability.

tools.title: YouTube Title Generator
tools.description: Free AI YouTube title generator. Create SEO-optimized, clickable titles that boost views and CTR.

fields.label: Video topic
fields.placeholder: e.g. How to deploy Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform

tools.systemPrompt: You are a YouTube SEO expert. Generate clickable, SEO-optimized video titles.
tools.userPrompt:
Generate 10 YouTube title options for:

Topic: {topic}
Style: {style}

Rules:
- Under 60 characters each
- Include power words (Ultimate, Complete, Secret, Easy, Fast)
- SEO-optimized with main keyword near start
- Mix of styles (curiosity, how-to, numbered)

Also suggest:

- Optimal description first line

fields.label: Target keywords
fields.placeholder: e.g. AI resume builder, free resume, ATS resume

tools.systemPrompt: You are an SEO expert specializing in meta descriptions that maximize click-through rates.
tools.userPrompt:
Write 5 SEO meta descriptions for:

Page: {page}
Keywords: {keywords}
Type: {type}

Rules:
- 150-160 characters each
- Include primary keyword naturally
- Include a CTA or value proposition
- Create urgency or curiosity

Also provide:

- H1 suggestion
